title: Build the change-stream client: listener, watchdog, stale state, reload on reconnect
statement: Subscribe to the stream, listen for the named heartbeat event, and run a watchdog that renders a visibly stale state — by text or icon, not colour alone — when a heartbeat does not arrive within its window. Reload on a change hint and on reconnection. No event buffer, event id or `Last-Event-ID` handling.
notes: ⚠️ Split from TSK-0011 on 2026-08-27. This is the half REQ-0018's second clause actually lands on. AST-0034 measured the skeleton's idle and dead streams as byte-identical and no client-side cleverness recovers a difference that was never transmitted — but equally, a heartbeat nothing listens for is not visibility either, so neither half is sufficient alone. ⚠️ Reload on reconnection is what removes the work: events are hints and never deltas (#73), so a reconnecting client that reloads is exactly caught up and no replay machinery is needed. ⚠️ DONE 2026-08-28. Thirteen deterministic tests plus a production check that the client half actually reaches the browser. ⚠️ ACC-0029 AND ACC-0030 REMAIN NOT-EVALUATED, DELIBERATELY. No browser was available, so a visibly stale page within the watchdog window and a reconnection that recovers a missed change have not been seen happening. They are the two criteria a reasonable person would most want ticked, which is precisely why they are not. ⚠️ THE BOUNDARY CHECK RELOCATED THE CODE. `lib/stream-watchdog.mjs` was refused by `lint:shell` on its first run; `app/server/*` was impossible because `server-only` throws in a client component. `app/_stream/logic.js` is neither tool nor adapter, which is what a client component needs — the same shape `app/_mdx/reject-js.js` already had. ⚠️ THE SMOKE CHECK LOOKS PAST THE HTML. Server-rendered markup for a client component is identical whether or not the script ships, so the check fetches every script the page loads and requires one to contain the component's own text. Falsified with a static stand-in that passes the markup assertions and fails only that one.
